name: msm-archive-audit
description: Audits mainstream media archives by comparing historical predictions and narratives with actual historical outcomes.

steps.name: archive-search
steps.prompt_template: Search Slovak and international mainstream media archives (SME, Pravda, Denník N, NYT, BBC) for predictions and core narratives regarding {{input}} from the specific historical period requested. Retrieve full article texts where available.

steps.name: outcome-verification
steps.prompt_template: Gather factual data and historical records on what actually transpired regarding the topic: {{input}}. Use primary historical sources, EU/UN statistical datasets, and peer-reviewed research. Cross-reference with Slovak national statistics (štatistiky.sk, ŠÚ SR).

steps.name: gap-analysis
steps.prompt_template: Compare the historical narratives: {{historical_narratives}} with the actual outcomes: {{actual_outcomes}}. Identify specific instances of accurate foresight, failed predictions, or systemic bias in the original reporting. Score each instance on a directional accuracy scale.

steps.name: accountability-report
steps.prompt_template: Synthesize the findings {{audit_findings}} into an 'Accountability Audit' report. Score the media outlets on their predictive accuracy and narrative integrity for this topic.
